correctness.rationale: An explicit four-pair transfer graph yields the exact number of periodic predecessors as an integer trace; cap-at-two products preserve zero/one/multiple counts. Exhaustive integer closure has 476 states and 136 singleton-accepting states. For the displayed D(z), the verifier proves the full 476-coordinate equality sum_{j=0}^{18} d_j T^{21-j} e=0 and the 21 exact numerator initial coefficients; multiplication yields the recurrence for all n>=21, not an empirical extension. Independent brute-force enumeration of every cyclic input through n=16 agrees, including n=1,2 conventions. Sources: RESULT.md proof, verify_transfer.py and verify_bruteforce.py. Limits: no all-fiber distribution, no independent audit.

value.rationale: The count of outputs with exactly one predecessor is the natural unique-decoding capacity of the classical finite cyclic majority map. Total image counts, homogeneous-predecessor counts, and attractor counts leave this invariant unknown; an exact rational series and verified all-length recurrence resolve it at every ring size. The result concerns a standard nonlinear rule and all lengths rather than an arbitrary short slice; the explicit reproducible certificate makes it usable for future finite-ring reconstruction comparisons. Scope is deliberately one-step and labelled; no downstream generalization is asserted.
